item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. High temperatures today range from thirty-eight to forty-one degrees, with lows tonight between twenty-nine and thirty-two, under cloudy to mostly cloudy skies across the region. Expect widespread rain and snow developing this morning and continuing through tonight, with precipitation chances as high as eighty to ninety percent and minor snow accumulation possible, especially overnight. Skies remain cloudy tonight as rain and snow taper off, with lingering showers and little or no additional accumulation expected.
